description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ResourceManager that manages Android resource files within a project, providing methods for resource directory retrieval, resource file processing, resource querying, and resource element collection.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: An abstract class providing resource management functionalities for Android projects, including resource directory handling, resource querying, and resource element collection.

methods.name: getAllResourceDirs
methods.description: Returns all resource directories for the module and its dependencies.

methods.name: getResourceDirs
methods.description: Returns resource directories for the module only.

methods.name: isResourceDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a resource directory in the module.

methods.name: processFileResources
methods.description: Processes resource files of a given type, optionally including dependencies and public resources only.

methods.name: getResourceOverlayDirs
methods.description: Returns resource overlay directories (default empty).

methods.name: getResourceSubdirs
methods.description: Returns subdirectories for a given resource type.

methods.name: findResourceFiles
methods.description: Finds resource files matching type, name, and extensions.

methods.name: getResourceElements
methods.description: Retrieves resource DOM elements from resource files.

methods.name: getRootDomElements
methods.description: Helper to get root DOM elements of a specific type from resource files.

methods.name: getAllValueResourceFiles
methods.description: Returns all 'values' resource XML files.

methods.name: getValueResources
methods.description: Retrieves value resources of a specific type.

methods.name: getValueResourceType
methods.description: Gets resource type from an XML tag if in 'values' directory.

methods.name: getFileResourceType
methods.description: Determines resource type of a file based on its directory.

methods.name: getFileResourcesNames
methods.description: Gets resource names from resource files of a specific type.

methods.name: getValueResourceNames
methods.description: Gets names of value resources of a specific type.

methods.name: getValueResourceEntries
methods.description: Retrieves resource entries for a given resource type.

methods.name: getResourceNames
methods.description: Combines file and value resource names, including IDs.

methods.name: getAttributeDefinitions
methods.description: Abstract method to get attribute definitions.

methods.name: findIdDeclarations
methods.description: Finds ID declarations matching a given ID.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Retrieves all resource IDs, optionally only declarations.

methods.name: getResourceSubdirsToSearchIds
methods.description: Returns resource subdirectories that provide IDs.

methods.name: findValueResources
methods.description: Finds value resources matching type and name.

methods.name: collectLazyResourceElements
methods.description: Collects resource elements lazily, including IDs and files.

methods.name: findValueResourceInfos
methods.description: Finds detailed info objects for value resources.
